Description = tagline from data/facts.json, homepage = https://mcp.zovo.one/s/<name>, topics mcp, mcp-server, model-context-protocol, claude, cursor + 3 server-specific. Pro-tier tests are skipped in mirrors: they need keys/license-private.pem, which stays in the monorepo
